Use Infrastructure Investor's platform to access the latest news, analysis, insights and fund data for National Printing and Binding Packaging Machinery Enterprise Pension Fund, as well as key contact information.

The National Printing and Binding Packaging Machinery Enterprise Pension Fund was established in July 1982 to ensure a stable retirement life and welfare of those employed at businesses in Japan whose main business is the manufacture, repair and sale of printing, platemaking, bookbinding, paper converting, packaging machinery and their associated peripheral equipment. It is an active LP investing into private equity, private debt, infrastructure and private equity real estate.

The Tokyo-based private pension fund will be more selective and invest into one new infrastructure fund in the next 12 months.
